locked_analysis.a2_primary_allowance: Requires a separate RS no-U scalar fit under A2: A_RS=sum_s abs(r_fit,s(x_s))+D0_RS. Do not infer fit or allowance from KS.
locked_analysis.convergence: Each run must have an actual Converged marker at conv_thr=3e-8; report selected iteration and final charge/R05 metrics.
locked_analysis.report: Record every input/seed/source/executable/CSV/log/output hash, signed D, D0, per-spin Tr(M1) and SUMEV, convergence marker, changes, and deviations from base. No KS criterion or uncertainty is imported.
locked_analysis.reporting: Report u_RS separately; do not add it to or replace the primary A2 allowance without explicit user approval.

deterministic_repeat.changes: None to accepted floor input, final restart seed, executable, source, runtime or physics.

runs.restart_rule: Both repeat and refinement start from a private copy of the accepted floor-run final Fe_out.nml (the accepted BASE FINAL seed), matching the KS repeat/refinement procedure. Do not use the pre-floor 240-step continuation seed.

spectral_refinement.reason: 6000 is the existing M0.1 RS quadrature refinement endpoint; factor 2.4 over base.
spectral_refinement.seed_rule: same accepted floor final Fe_out.nml as repeat
